jpGuide1:
※選択ミスをするとBADEND
●剣が見えた
YES
jpGuide2: （第二ガイドに記載なし）
enGuide: Di-Sword quiz, statement 1 of 5: 「剣が見えた」 ("I saw a sword"). The statements come one at a time, each with a YES door and a NO door, and the next statement depends on your previous answer. Checked in-game on the stock Steam build (build 9206428) and with Overhaul Patch 1.1.3: YES here leads to 「はっきりと剣が見えた」, NO leads to 「剣っぽいものは見えた」. This step follows the Steam chart (Set A): YES. Two other answer paths were also played through and continued the game: YES, YES, NO, NO, YES and NO, NO, YES, NO, YES (see the next steps). Other combinations were not tried, and the guides say that a wrong answer ends the game, so stay on one of these three paths.

jpGuide1:
●はっきりと剣が見えた
NO
jpGuide2: （第二ガイドに記載なし）
enGuide: Statement 2 of 5. After YES at the first statement the game shows 「はっきりと剣が見えた」 ("I clearly saw a sword"): NO leads to 「なんとなく剣に見えただけ」 (this chart), YES leads to 「ここから動けるなら取りに行ける」 (played path YES, YES, NO, NO, YES). After NO at the first statement it shows 「剣っぽいものは見えた」 ("I saw something sword-like"): NO leads to 「幻覚としては見えた」 (played path NO, NO, YES, NO, YES). Answer NO here.

jpGuide1:
●なんとなく剣に見えただけ
YES
jpGuide2: （第二ガイドに記載なし）
enGuide: Statement 3 of 5. 「なんとなく剣に見えただけ」 ("It only vaguely looked like a sword"): YES (this chart). On the other played paths: 「ここから動けるなら取りに行ける」 ("If I could move from here I could go and get it") = NO; 「幻覚としては見えた」 ("I saw it as a hallucination") = YES.

jpGuide1:
●ここ以外の場所でもその剣は見える
NO
jpGuide2: ここ以外の場所でもその剣は見える：NO
enGuide: Statement 4 of 5: 「ここ以外の場所でもその剣は見える」 ("I can see that sword from other places too") = NO on all three played paths.

jpGuide1:
●実際にはそれは剣じゃない
YES
jpGuide2: 実際にはそれは剣じゃない：YES
enGuide: Statement 5 of 5: 「実際にはそれは剣じゃない」 ("It is not actually a sword") = YES on all three played paths. After it the next delusion trigger (「…………」) follows. The 七海 section is the only one without this quiz.
